bifrost: bifrost_app::view (springboard/sdk/src/view/animation.rs, controls.rs), bifrost_ui::anim (springboard/ui/src/anim.rs), render::motion (springboard/render/src/motion.rs); compositor springboard/src/gpu/layer.rs (not app-facing)
summary: Typed-property animation exists for views (frame, opacity, background) with transactions, completions, actions, springs and retargeting. A retained layer tree (layer model, delegates, constraint layout) backs layer-backed views, and app-facing views exist for shape, gradient, text, replicator, emitter, tiled and scroll layers. Key-path animations, 3D transforms, corner radius and shadows exist as models or view properties. The compositor underneath is not exposed to apps, and no layer class is a public CALayer counterpart yet.

gaps: No public CALayer class hierarchy for apps: layers are reached through ViewBase::layer and the layer-kind views.
No keyframe, group or additive animations driven by the SDK window (keypath_anim.rs and keyframe models exist but are not the SDK's animate path).
No key-path animations through Window::animate (typed view properties only).
Gradient, text, replicator and emitter layers render through layer-kind views; per-property parity is not yet checked on Midget.
No app-facing CADisplayLink object or frame-rate preference (CAFrameRateRange) request API.
No app-facing Metal layer or drawable (CAMetalLayer, CAMetalDrawable); the compositor is system-only.
Initial spring velocity and mass are not exposed to apps through Timing::spring.
Layer filters beyond background blur are not modelled (per-shader inventory pending).
